$description: Dark tints. deepGreenPage is the dark bg.page direction (deep green, no pink). plumLight now covers brand.link, brand.eyebrow, and focus.ring — all three moved off the magenta/rust family in light mode, so their dark tints follow the same hue (plum), per this file's own rule that a dark tint is always its light counterpart's hue, only re-lightened. magentaLight and rustLight are gone: nothing references them now that link/eyebrow/focus all point to plum.

plumLight.$description: brand.link, brand.eyebrow, focus.ring (dark) — lightened plum, same hue as their light-mode value. 11.28:1 vs bg.page, 9.95:1 vs bg.surface — clears both the 4.5:1 text floor and the 3:1 UI-indicator floor with heavy margin.

deepGreenPage.$description: New Palette D primitive: dark theme bg.page. Deep green direction, replacing the reused charcoal — no pink in dark mode.

tealSubtle.$description: status.infoSubtle fill (dark). Pending Palette D recompute.

tealStrong.$description: status.onInfo foreground (dark). Also reused as dark focus.ring under Palette D.

amberSubtle.$description: status.warningSubtle fill (dark). Pending Palette D recompute.

amberStrong.$description: status.onWarning foreground (dark). Pending Palette D recompute.

crimsonSubtle.$description: status.dangerSubtle fill (dark). Pending Palette D recompute.

crimsonStrong.$description: status.onDanger foreground (dark). Pending Palette D recompute.
